en.summary: Fixes TCU micro-op expansion so special-register read/write dependency masks are preserved on emitted uops instead of being dropped.
why_it_counts: The patch repairs control metadata that downstream scheduling and hazard logic uses.
It is in the RTL micro-op expander, not in tests or software.
The missing fields are architecturally relevant because the same tree's scoreboard tracks rd_xregs and wr_xregs hazards.
evidence: It adds ibuf_out.rd_xregs = ibuf_in.rd_xregs and ibuf_out.wr_xregs = ibuf_in.wr_xregs.
In the same commit tree, hw/rtl/core/VX_scoreboard.sv computes xreg hazards from ibuffer_if.data.rd_xregs | ibuffer_if.data.wr_xregs.
Without these assignments, expanded TCU uops would lose special-register dependency information even though other fields are forwarded.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When one decoded instruction expands into multiple micro-ops, each emitted uop must carry the same special-register dependency metadata that the scheduler and scoreboard expect. If the expander drops read/write masks for control or status registers, downstream hazard tracking can issue those uops in the wrong order or fail to reserve/release special resources correctly.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: special-register dependency propagation through micro-op expansion
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any expanded execution op whose original decoded form reads a control register or writes a status register such as rounding mode or exception flags.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Clear, omit, or stop forwarding the special-register read/write masks on the generated micro-ops while leaving the rest of the uop intact.
portability_notes: This applies to any macro-op expander that clones an instruction header onto several internal uops.
Use a control-register or flag register dependency, not a normal integer/floating register dependency.
The bug is about metadata propagation, so the arithmetic function of the uop can remain unchanged.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the expander logic that copies decoded instruction header fields into each generated micro-op.
Remove the forwarding of special-register read and write masks, or force them to zero on the expanded uops.
Keep the opcode, source registers, destination register, and writeback enable unchanged so only dependency tracking is corrupted.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_tcu_uops output-header propagation for rd_xregs and wr_xregs
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix copies rd_xregs and wr_xregs from ibuf_in to ibuf_out in the TCU uop expander.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete the two assignments that forward ibuf_in.rd_xregs and ibuf_in.wr_xregs into ibuf_out.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Expanded TCU uops can bypass scoreboard constraints on special registers, causing misordered issue, stale control-state reads, or incorrect flag-write timing.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change in the commit is forwarding rd_xregs and wr_xregs.
VX_scoreboard uses these masks to form xreg hazard state in the same commit tree.
The bug is localized to metadata propagation and does not require changing datapath computation.
notes: This is a clean reverse mutation with very small surface area.
The most likely visible symptoms involve FRM or FFLAGS-like special-register hazards.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 TCU 微操作展开逻辑，使生成的 uop 能保留特殊寄存器读写依赖掩码，而不是把这些信息丢掉。
why_it_counts: 补丁修复了下游调度和冒险检测逻辑依赖的控制元数据。
修改发生在 RTL 微操作展开器中，而不是测试或软件中。
这些缺失字段在体系结构上是重要的，因为同一代码树中的 scoreboard 会跟踪 rd_xregs 和 wr_xregs 冒险。
evidence: 补丁新增了 ibuf_out.rd_xregs = ibuf_in.rd_xregs 和 ibuf_out.wr_xregs = ibuf_in.wr_xregs。
在同一提交树中，hw/rtl/core/VX_scoreboard.sv 会用 ibuffer_if.data.rd_xregs | ibuffer_if.data.wr_xregs 计算 xreg 冒险。
如果没有这两条赋值，展开后的 TCU uop 即使转发了其他字段，也会丢失特殊寄存器依赖信息。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一条已解码指令被展开为多个微操作时，每个生成的 uop 都必须携带调度器和 scoreboard 所需的特殊寄存器依赖元数据。如果展开器丢掉了控制寄存器或状态寄存器的读写掩码，下游冒险跟踪就可能错误地发射这些 uop，或者错误地保留/释放特殊资源。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 微操作展开过程中的特殊寄存器依赖传播
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任何展开后的执行操作，其原始已解码形式会读取控制寄存器或写入状态寄存器，例如舍入模式或异常标志。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在保持 uop 其他内容不变的情况下，把生成微操作上的特殊寄存器读写掩码清零、遗漏或停止转发。
portability_notes: 该缺陷适用于任何把一条宏操作拆成多个内部 uop 的展开器。
应选用控制寄存器或标志寄存器依赖，而不是普通整数/浮点寄存器依赖。
这是元数据传播缺陷，因此不需要改变 uop 的算术功能。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位把已解码指令头字段复制到每个生成微操作的展开逻辑。
删除特殊寄存器读写掩码的转发，或者强制这些掩码在展开后的 uop 上为零。
保持操作码、源寄存器、目的寄存器和写回使能不变，只破坏依赖跟踪信息。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_tcu_uops 中 rd_xregs 和 wr_xregs 的输出头字段传播
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 TCU uop 展开器中把 rd_xregs 和 wr_xregs 从 ibuf_in 复制到 ibuf_out。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除把 ibuf_in.rd_xregs 和 ibuf_in.wr_xregs 转发到 ibuf_out 的两条赋值语句。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 展开后的 TCU uop 可能绕过 special register 的 scoreboard 约束，导致发射顺序错误、控制状态读取过期，或标志写回时序错误。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交唯一的功能性修改就是转发 rd_xregs 和 wr_xregs。
同一提交树中的 VX_scoreboard 使用这些掩码形成 xreg 冒险状态。
该缺陷局限在元数据传播，不需要改变数据通路计算。
notes: 这是一个很干净的反向注入，改动面非常小。
最可能出现的可见症状与 FRM 或 FFLAGS 一类特殊寄存器冒险有关。
